text: I'd say it's quite important, since films are one of the most effective ways of passing on a country's stories, language and values. Without a local industry, young people would grow up consuming only foreign content, which could weaken their cultural identity. Admittedly, local films often have much smaller budgets than Hollywood productions, but they can win audiences through authenticity and original storytelling.

tips.en: Without … would shows a hypothetical consequence.
tips.example: Without a local industry, young people would grow up consuming only foreign content

tips.en: Admittedly admits a weakness before the counterargument.
tips.kk: Admittedly әлсіз жағын мойындап, сосын қарсы дәлел келеді.
tips.ru: Admittedly признаёт слабость, затем идёт контраргумент.
tips.example: Admittedly, local films often have much smaller budgets

note.en: Sense of who a culture is.

text: In some ways, yes. People are spending more time on short videos and social media, which can reduce their attention span for long texts. On the other hand, e-books and audiobooks have made reading more accessible than ever, so the habit isn't disappearing so much as changing form. To encourage reading, schools could let students choose books they genuinely enjoy rather than assigning only classics.

tips.en: The structure reframes: not vanishing but changing.
tips.ru: Конструкция меняет угол: не исчезает, а меняется.
tips.example: the habit isn't disappearing so much as changing form

tips.en: Rather than ends with a clear alternative.

tips.ru: Rather than завершает предложение чёткой альтернативой.

text: It depends on the audience. Dubbing makes content accessible to everyone, including children and older people who may not speak foreign languages, and it supports the local language. However, I personally favour subtitles, since they let you hear the original performance and are also a great way of picking up a foreign language. The best solution would be to offer both options.

tips.en: It depends on … buys thinking time and sounds natural.
tips.kk: It depends on … ойлануға уақыт беріп, табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: It depends on … даёт время подумать и звучит естественно.

tips.en: Would be to softens the recommendation.
tips.example: The best solution would be to offer both options

questions.question: Is it a good idea for films and TV programmes to be translated into the local language?

text: Quite a lot, actually. Films, music and television reveal what people find funny, what they worry about and what they consider important, such as family values or social issues. That said, popular culture can be misleading, because it often focuses on extremes or follows stereotypes. So I think it's best treated as a starting point for understanding a country, not as the full picture.

tips.example: That said, popular culture can be misleading

note.en: Repeats simple ideas about a group.
